expectedRealization.rationale: Winter curtailment can support steel margins for a season, but construction restrictions simultaneously suppress demand and the frozen equity regime is adverse.

changeHypothesis.summary: Northern winter environmental controls materially restrict steel capacity, but the same policy environment also restricts construction activity, creating a genuine supply-demand conflict rather than a simple bullish capacity state.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Heating-season restrictions last months, but both supply and end-demand effects move at the same time.
disconfirmingEvidence: Frozen steel basket is adverse over both 20d and 60d.
BaoSteel earnings are strong but do not isolate a relative allowed-capacity advantage.

evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: Policy simultaneously constrains steel supply and construction demand.
Large producer earnings are strong but not a clean geography/compliance edge.
Steel equity regime is mechanically adverse.

causalChain.mechanism: Sintering/blast-furnace operating restrictions cut effective production.
causalChain.failureMode: demand falls as fast or faster

causalChain.mechanism: Earthwork/project restrictions reduce seasonal construction consumption.

falseThemeMatches: generic steel beta without company-specific curtailment advantage

selectionComparison.rationale: Supply contraction is real, but demand offset and lack of a frozen company-specific allowed-capacity advantage make the opportunity unresolved.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: Steel basket was -10.09pp excess over 20d and -4.47pp over 60d with weak breadth.
expectations.thesisExpectation: Do not infer a broad steel long from a supply restriction that also suppresses construction demand.
expectations.measurableGap: No company-level asymmetry is verified strongly enough to offset the conflicted state and adverse tape.

hypothesisDecompositionTest.productMarketScope: heating-season steel capacity and construction demand
hypothesisDecompositionTest.geographicScope: Northern China with national steel pricing spillovers
hypothesisDecompositionTest.rationale: The broad event requires company geography/product/compliance decomposition before any selection.

nearTerm.driver: supply curtailment versus construction demand restriction

mediumTerm.driver: winter margin support versus demand normalization

structural.driver: environmental compliance reshapes costs/capacity but cycle remains commodity-driven

evidenceHorizonMatrix.resolutionRule: Fail closed until a company-specific allowed-capacity/margin advantage is verified.

leaderDivergenceTest.rationale: BaoSteel earnings are strong but no clean curtailment-relative edge is frozen.

upstreamState.economicRole: sets available steel supply during heating-season controls

downstreamFlow.temporaryDistortion: Construction itself is restricted, so lower supply does not map monotonically to stronger producer earnings.

causalLagBridge.rationale: Both supply and demand are policy-distorted in opposite directions.

crossSectionalCorroboration.rationale: No company-specific allowed-capacity/compliance advantage is frozen.

causalStateVariableTest.falsifier: A producer with verified relative operating allowance/product-mix advantage and earnings conversion is identified.

bearCase: Supply restrictions are offset by weaker construction demand, leaving broad steel equities without a positive earnings gap.

invalidationConditions.threshold: demand remains strong while curtailment persists

nextResearchActions: No selection; require company-specific geography/compliance and demand evidence rather than a broad steel call.
